chunks: If a slave runs away but does not leave his city, he is not considered a runaway.
ai.seo_question: When is a slave considered legally a runaway according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states a legal distinction regarding an absconding slave. The ruling clarifies that merely fleeing within one’s own city does not make the slave legally classified as an abiq (runaway).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3535 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"If a slave runs away but does not leave his city, he is not considered a runaway (abiq)."
